description: This file defines classes that extend grain state with versioning metadata and ETag information for Orleans-based log-view consistent grains. It includes the implementation of GrainStateWithMetaData<TView> and GrainStateWithMetaDataAndETag<TView> classes, which help manage version tracking, serialization, and state management with metadata and identifiers.

classes.name: GrainStateWithMetaData<TView>
classes.description: Class that extends grain state with versioning metadata and a write vector for concurrency control, parameterized by the view type.

classes.name: GrainStateWithMetaDataAndETag<TView>
classes.description: Class that extends grain state with additional ETag metadata for versioning and concurrency, containing an instance of GrainStateWithMetaData and synchronized metadata fields.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the GrainStateWithMetaDataAndETag object, including version, flags, ETag, and data.

methods.name: GetBit
methods.description: Retrieves the bit value associated with a specific replica in the write vector.

methods.name: FlipBit
methods.description: Toggles the bit associated with a specific replica in the write vector and returns the new bit value.
